beats.text: Bro pulled up acting like the final boss of Vice City, screaming and waving guns just to steal a bike.
Even his hype man backed him up. So yeah, I politely stepped off.
He really hit me with a polite 'Appreciate it'... and immediately forgot how steering works. Ten out of ten robbery.
